channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donnie Walsh | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donnie Walsh from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird
item.description:
Ramasar:

“He’s excited. There are a lot of memories up in Toronto, and a lot of good memories. Although things have changed to where he’s been moved, he’s ecstatic about the opportunity ahead of him in Indiana. First of all, it’s a first-class organization. When you look at [President] Kevin Pritchard and [general manager] Chad Buchanan, these are basketball guys with an organization that always has had basketball executives from Larry Bird to Donnie Walsh that have been there. Their front office is first class.”

Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird, Jan 18, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Herb Simon on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
“Over my thirty-year relationship with Donnie, I have been amazed to watch him help lead this organization to what it has become,”

Herb Simon on Donnie Walsh, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Fieldhouse Files.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
“This will be a part of my speech. During my 18 years, I only had one general manager-president in Donnie Walsh. … Now that he's back in control with the Pacers, I'm very excited about that.”

Reggie Miller on Donnie Walsh, Sep 4, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: David Morway on Donnie Walsh, Herb Simon
item.description:
Morway said in a statement released by the team.

“After discussing all of these issues with our owner Herb Simon and (president) Larry (Bird), I believe this is the right time to step away. “I want to thank Mr. Simon, Larry, (former team president) Donnie Walsh and (president) Jim Morris for the opportunity they gave me and the friendship and mentorship they provided.”

David Morway on Donnie Walsh, Herb Simon, Jun 26, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Chris Mullin on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Mullin, a former Golden State Warriors executive, said he and Walsh talked about the gig but talks never progressed.

“With Donnie Walsh, that's the guy I consider the right person [to work for] for sure,”

Chris Mullin on Donnie Walsh, Aug 15, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: David Stern on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Whatever the reason for Donnie Walsh's departure as Knicks president -- forced out or left of his own choosing -- he should be proud of his New York tenure, NBA commissioner David Stern said yesterday.

“Donnie can look back and feel good about a job well done,”

David Stern on Donnie Walsh, Jun 7, 2011. Source: New York Post.

item.title: David Stern on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Stern, who helped sway the franchise to hire Walsh in the first place, said following the dedication of a new grammar school learn-and-play center here through the cooperation of NBA Cares, HP and State Farm.

“I think that both Donnie and the Knicks are content with the outcome,”

David Stern on Donnie Walsh, Jun 7, 2011. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh
item.description:
“I screwed up the other night when I said something about Mike D'Antoni that wasn't cool. I want to apologize to Mike D'Antoni and Donnie Walsh. When you're on television you should never talk about someone getting hired and fired. That's inappropriate. I made that mistake. I want to apologize personally to Mike D'Antoni and Donnie Walsh. I've got great respect for Donnie Walsh and Mike D'Antoni. I want to apologize. That's all I can do.”

Charles Barkley on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh, Apr 23, 2011. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Colangelo has a connection with Knicks head coach Mike D'Antoni, hiring the coach in Phoenix when he was the Suns' GM.

“I have too much respect for Donnie to comment on baseless speculation,”

Bryan Colangelo on Donnie Walsh, Apr 6, 2011. Source: TSN.

item.title: David Kahn on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Kahn said he does not envision Walsh retiring.

“I know Donnie well enough to know he would be very difficult for him to not work,”

David Kahn on Donnie Walsh, Nov 13, 2010. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Thomas said in a statement.

“Because of this, I have decided to rescind my contract with the team. I have nothing but the utmost respect for [owner] Jim Dolan, [general manager] Donnie Walsh, [coach] Mike D'Antoni and the entire Knicks organization, and I want to thank them for affording me this opportunity.”

Isiah Thomas on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh, Aug 11, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Thomas:

“Donnie Walsh and I and Jim and I, we’ve have always had great respect for each other. Donnie and I have worked with each other. Actually, Donnie gave me my first job in the NBA in terms of coaching with the Indiana Pacers. The relationships that we have and our ability to work together and understand how tough it is to win in New York and try to assemble talent to go out there and compete, I’m glad they have given me the opportunity to come back.”

Isiah Thomas on Donnie Walsh, Aug 9, 2010. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh
item.description:
Mobley said after working out in Los Angeles.

“I'm not angry at the Knicks. They were looking out for me and protecting their own interests. I like Donnie Walsh as a man and as a general manager. I wanted to play in Mike D'Antoni's system. It just didn't work out. There are no hard feelings.”

Cuttino Mobley on Mike D'Antoni, Donnie Walsh, Jul 1, 2010. Source: New York Daily News.
